name: Mayonaka Pyon-Pyon Café Morning!
original_name: まよなかぴょんぴょんカフェ もーにんぐ!
source:
I'm Karin Tsukimiya. I work at the Mayonaka Cafe with my sister Yuzu and Plum.

One day, the store manager suddenly decided to leave the store. Now I have to be a deputy store manager! But no customers are coming ...

"Is there any good way to attract customers?"
"I have a good idea..."
translation:
我是月宫花梨，和妹妹柚子、李子一起在午夜咖啡馆工作。

某一天，店长突然决定离开店里，于是我只好当起了代理店长！可是，一个客人都没有来……

“有没有什么招揽客人的好办法呢？”
“我有个好主意……”
